title: DirectImageTruncationTailBound
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $N$ be an integer such that $H^m(Rf_*K)=0$ for $m\ge N$ whenever $K\in D_{QCoh}(O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] has no positive cohomology [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every $E\in D_{QCoh}(O_X)$ and integers $n,j$ with $N\le j+n+1$, one has $H^j(Rf_*\tau_{<-n}E)=0$ [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category].

proof.text: Put T = tau_{<-n}E. Its cohomology is either zero or the corresponding cohomology of E, so T and its shift T[-n-1] have quasi-coherent cohomology. The standard truncation bound gives H^m(T[-n-1])=H^{m-n-1}(T)=0 for m>0. Apply the supplied bound in degree j+n+1, then transport along shift compatibility of derived direct image and homology to obtain H^j(Rf_*T)=0. This argument works for arbitrary integer n,j,N, including negative values.

theorem directImage_truncation_tail_bound
    {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (N : ℤ)
    (hN : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      (∀ m : ℤ, 0 < m → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) m).obj E.obj)) →
      ∀ m : ℤ, N ≤ m → IsZero ((schemeHigherDirectImage f m).obj E.obj))
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (n j : ℤ) (hj : N ≤ j + n + 1) :
    IsZero ((schemeHigherDirectImage f j).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLT (-n)).obj E.obj))
